2607.27652.title: Harness-G: A Graph-Structured Harness for Search Agents
2607.27652.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) search agents commonly model retrieval as free-form natural-language query generation and optimize multi-turn interactions using final-answer rewards. Current studies mainly improve training with denser or more structured credit signals, but rarely examine whether retrieval is properly formulated at the policy-environment interface. We observe pronounced retrieval aliasing during Search-R1 training: rollouts for the same question continue to generate distinct query strings, yet their accumulated evidence sets increasingly overlap. We call this phenomenon retrieval-equivalence collapse; in this regime, trajectories approach utility equivalence with respect to retrieval decisions, leaving within-group returns with little effective retrieval contrast. To address this problem, we propose Harness-G, a graph-structured retrieval framework that redesigns this interface. It reformulates free-form query generation as finite action selection: the policy selects an evidence sentence or entity, or chooses to answer, while the environment constructs the menu, tracks retrieval state, and validates and executes each choice. This interface reduces linguistic aliasing and makes same-state alternatives directly comparable. Building on this interface, we introduce Structured Non-myopic Credit (SNC), which uses a frozen answer scorer to compare the selected action with its alternatives and assigns downstream gains to the earlier actions that enabled them. Across six QA benchmarks, Harness-G achieves the highest average F1 at both evaluated model scales, outperforming the strongest baseline, Graph-R1, by 10.74 points at 1.5B and 3.98 points at 3B.
2607.27652.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習 (RL) 搜索代理通常將檢索建模為自由形式的自然語言查詢生成，並使用最終答案獎勵來優化多輪互動。當前的研究主要通過更密集或更結構化的信用信號來改善訓練，但很少檢查檢索是否在政策-環境介面上正確表述。我們在 Search-R1 訓練期間觀察到顯著的檢索別名現象：對於相同問題的展開仍然生成不同的查詢字符串，但它們的累積證據集越來越重疊。我們稱這種現象為檢索等價崩潰；在這種情況下，軌跡在檢索決策上接近效用等價，導致組內回報幾乎沒有有效的檢索對比。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 Harness-G，一個圖結構的檢索框架，重新設計了這個介面。它將自由形式的查詢生成重新表述為有限的行動選擇：政策選擇一個證據句子或實體，或選擇回答，而環境則構建菜單，跟踪檢索狀態，並驗證和執行每個選擇。這個介面減少了語言別名，使同狀態的替代方案可以直接比較。在這個介面的基礎上，我們引入了結構化非短視信用 (SNC)，它使用凍結的答案評分器來比較所選行動及其替代方案，並將下游收益分配給使其成為可能的早期行動。在六個 QA 基準測試中，Harness-G 在兩個評估模型規模上都達到了最高的平均 F1，超過了最強的基準 Graph-R1，分別提高了 10.74 分（在 1.5B）和 3.98 分（在 3B）。
